title: Admission Core
prompt: Implement `AdmissionsCore` exactly to spec: first-config tag limits, per-window usage and ordinals, unknown-tag rejection, running totals.

tests.name: limits battery
tests.hint: setTagLimit returns false for tag < 0, limit < 1, or a re-set of an existing tag; true only on first successful configuration.

tests.name: admission + window rollover battery
tests.hint: admit rejects unknown tags and over-limit tags; the first admit at a new timestamp clears usage and ordinals (next ordinal is 1 again).
